method: Fresh independent read-only source audit of the exact 23 assigned web test/fixture files. Read AGENTS.md and the current assignment/frozen inventory; honored the user two-complete-clean-round gate override and ran no full suite. Read every assigned file in full, including complete test bodies, data fixtures, fetch/WebSocket mocks, every assertion, before/after cleanup, parameterized cases, deferred promise resolution/rejection and fake-timer paths; the first batched output truncated input-context.test.tsx, so that file was reread completely in an individual call before claiming coverage. Examined API receipt identity and monotonic-state assumptions, no-replay assertions, draft revision ownership, A-to-B-to-A transitions, parent remount/visibility behavior, cancellation, bounded media and logs, prototype-key inputs, explicit mutation consent and local fixture shutdown/listen errors. Cross-referenced current production implementations and actual App-to-Workspace-to-Settings/Extensions reachability where needed, rather than treating isolated component rerenders as parent integration evidence. Inspected vitest.config.ts to confirm clearMocks/restoreMocks and test isolation assumptions. The preview fixture was reviewed as a real local HTTP/WebSocket server, including raw-body byte bounds, read allowlist, path containment, import side effects, owned connection cleanup and timeout ownership. Independently SHA-256-verified all 1901 raw inventory files before and after the semantic review, and invoked the canonical exported snapshot() from scripts/snapshot.mjs both times using the pinned Node v24.22.1 binary. No source edits, previous checkout/history, prior audit reports/findings, credentials, native/remote services, external MCP or paid inference were used. No actionable candidate required a local reproduction; this report records static semantic audit completion, not test execution success.
limitations: No tests, browser rendering, native worker, remote deployment or real external integration were executed during this audit. The user full-suite gate remained closed.

jsdom mocks and synthetic media headers establish the assertions being made, not actual browser decoding, browser security enforcement, or remote OAuth/provider behavior; those integrations were not runtime-verified.
Production cross-references were targeted to contracts, ownership and parent reachability relevant to the assigned tests; they do not claim a complete independent audit of every production module.
